given: a package adds a postinstall hook that posts the full process environment to a base64-encoded chat webhook URL

should_find.finding: the postinstall script sends process.env, including every secret available to the installing machine, to a Discord webhook URL that is hidden behind a base64 literal, and runs on every npm install

should_not_find: the base64 encoding of the webhook URL reported as a second finding separate from the exfiltration itself
request errors are swallowed by the empty error handler
the telemetry opt-out environment variable is undocumented
